fragment_name: Federal rules and constitutional research sources

sources.display_name: Current Federal Rules of Practice and Procedure
sources.description: Official national federal rules in effect, including appellate, bankruptcy, civil, criminal, evidence, and Section 2254/2255 proceedings.
sources.publisher: Administrative Office of the United States Courts / House Committee on the Judiciary
sources.acquisition_basis: Reviewed allowlist of the six current national-rules PDFs linked by the official Current Rules of Practice & Procedure index; no recursive crawl.
sources.coverage_notes: The collection is the current national rules only. It excludes pending amendments, superseded editions, local rules, and interim rules. Appellate forms and other forms included inside an official rules PDF remain forms rather than binding rule text.

sources.description: The Constitution of the United States of America: Analysis and Interpretation, prepared by the Congressional Research Service and published by Congress and GPO.
sources.publisher: Congressional Research Service / Library of Congress / U.S. Government Publishing Office
sources.acquisition_basis: Reviewed GovInfo package URLs for the authenticated 2022 edition and 2024 supplement; the regularly updated Library of Congress site remains the canonical research link.
sources.coverage_notes: This is authoritative congressional legal analysis, not binding primary law. The initial retained set is the 2022 decennial edition plus the 2024 supplement and is not represented as a complete snapshot of the continuously updated website.
